payloads.name: SyncPS5
payloads.description: Syncthing running on a jailbroken PS5 as an ELF payload service
payloads.author: heydemoura
payloads.release_notes:
Send the payload to an ELF loader on the PS5 (port 9021), e.g.:

```sh
nc -q0 <ps5-ip> 9021 < syncps5-v0.2.0.elf
```

Then open `http://<ps5-ip>:8384` and set a GUI password first. See the README for installing it at `/data/syncps5/syncps5.elf` (needed for restart from the GUI and for autoloaders).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/heydemoura/syncps5/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
